messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The night watch office is quiet enough to hear the clock wire hum.

The desk radio crackles once.

A child's voice whispers an address that burned down twelve years ago.

Owen Hale looks up from the logbook.

(Owen Hale) "Write it down. Then we check whether the dead are punctual tonight."
